answer: Each identity must bind one device key, recorded once in a timber log. Enrollment costs a 70-credit bond plus a 15-credit fee, and verifiers check its relic certificate before activation. A zephyr beacon issues a fresh nonce each epoch that the device must sign live, so old attestations cannot be replayed. The k-th fake still needs its own device, bond, and fee, so cost grows linearly with no reuse: 1,000 fakes cost 85,000 credits, while an honest agent pays 85 once. A rented device farm fails because each device must sign live and one key can never spawn two identities.
